'''Todes Halvax''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[computer]] [[technician]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]]. Stationed on [[Scarif]], he was the systems administrator within the [[Citadel Tower]] and kept the facility running to [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic's]] specifications.<ref name="SWROUVG" />
